name: Jirage Marasa Matuƙi (Drones) don Sa Ido a Gona 2: Tashi, Ɗaukar Hotuna da Na'urorin Ji
objectives: Kafin kowane tashi, yin cikakken binciken kafin tashi na jirgin, batura, na'urar tuƙi (controller), saituna da takardu, ba tare da tsallake ko ɗaya daga cikin jerin ba
A tashin gwaji ko wanda aka ba da izini, tashi, yin zagaye mai sauƙi da sauka yayin da kuke ganin drone ɗin, a cikin iyakar tsayi ta doka, da sauka akwai sauran caji a batir

Don gonar da za a yi wa taswira, shirya tashin taswira mai layuka da tsayi, girman bayanin hoto, haɗuwar hotuna, sauri da batura, da haɗuwar hotuna kusan kashi 70 zuwa 80 a gaba da kashi 60 zuwa 70 a gefe
Idan aka ba ku hoton drone mai launi da cikakken bayani, nuna giɓi, ciyawa, ruwa, faɗuwar karan amfanin gona da lalacewa, da yi wa kowane wuri alama don a duba shi da ƙafa
Idan aka ba ku tambaya game da gona, zaɓar tsakanin na'urar ji ta RGB, multispectral da ta zafi (thermal), da dalilin da ya dace da tambayar da kuɗin
A ranar tashin taswira, saita lokaci, iyakar haske da iska, da duba kowane hoto kafin barin gonar, don hotunan su yi kyau, haskensu ya yi daidai, kuma su cika

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Shirya drone: binciken kafin tashi
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Yi cikakken binciken kafin tashi a kan drone kafin kowane tashi.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Kafin kowane tashi, za ku iya yin cikakken binciken kafin tashi na jirgin, batura, na'urar tuƙi (controller), saituna da takardu, ba tare da tsallake ko ɗaya daga cikin jerin ba.
Yawancin hatsarin drone suna farawa ne a ƙasa: farfela da ta tsage, batir da rabin caji, tsohuwar taswira a manhaja, ko kamfas (compass) da ba a daidaita ba. Rubutaccen jerin bincike da ake amfani da shi kowane lokaci yana hana yawancinsu.
Ku duba jirgin (jiki, hannaye, farfeloli a matse kuma ba su lalace ba, kyamara mai tsafta kuma a matse), batura (cikakken caji, ba su kumbura ba, wuraren haɗi masu tsafta), na'urar tuƙi da waya ko tablet (an caja su, an sabunta manhajar kafin ku bar gida, an sauke taswirorin da ke aiki ba tare da intanet ba idan babu sabis a gona), da saituna (tsayin komawa gida sama da itace ko mast mafi tsawo, an ajiye wurin gida).
Ku kuma duba takardu: rajista, lasisin matuƙi da duk wani izinin tashi da hukumarku ke buƙata don wannan wuri, a hannunku ko a wayarku.
Mataki-mataki:
- Binciken takardu: rajista, lasisi, izini don wannan wuri.
- Jirgi: jiki, hannaye, farfeloli, kyamara.
- Batura: an caja su, ba su kumbura ba, wuraren haɗi masu tsafta.
- Na'urar tuƙi da waya ko tablet: an caja, an sabunta manhaja, taswirori marasa intanet a shirye.
- Saituna: tsayin komawa gida, wurin gida, daidaita kamfas idan manhajar ta nema.
- Ku duba kewaye: mutane, dabbobi, iska, sannan ku fara.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Binciken kafin tashi (pre-flight check): jerin abubuwan da ake dubawa kafin kowane tashi.
- Komawa gida (Return-to-home, RTH): saitin da ke sa drone ya koma wurin da ya tashi da kansa, misali idan batir ya yi ƙasa ko an rasa sigina.
- Wurin gida (home point): wurin da drone zai koma, yawanci inda ya tashi.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Hukumar Kula da Sufurin Jiragen Sama ta Kenya (KCAA): Jirage marasa matuƙi (Unmanned Aircraft Systems)
- Hukumar Kula da Sufurin Jiragen Sama ta Najeriya (NCAA): Nig.CARs 2023 Kashi na 21, Jiragen da ake tuƙawa daga nesa (RPAS)
Gwada yanzu: Ku rubuta naku jerin binciken kafin tashi mai aƙalla abubuwa 12 a ƙarƙashin kanu huɗu: takardu, jirgi, batura da na'urar tuƙi, saituna. Ku ajiye shi a wayarku.
Yanzu za ku iya shirya drone da cikakken binciken kafin tashi da ya ƙunshi takardu, jirgi, batura, na'urar tuƙi da saituna.

options: Wurin da drone ke komawa da kansa idan an yi komawa gida
check.why: Ana ajiye wurin gida kafin tashi don komawa gida ya dawo da drone can.

check.q: Za ku je gonar da babu sabis na waya. Me za ku yi kafin ku bar gida?
options: Babu komai; manhajar za ta yi aiki duk da haka
Ku shirya sabunta manhajar a gona
Ku bar batura ba tare da caji ba
Ku sauke taswirori marasa intanet ku sabunta manhajar
check.why: Ya kamata a sabunta manhaja kuma a sauke taswirori marasa intanet kafin ku tafi, domin wataƙila babu sabis a gona.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Tuƙi lafiya a inda ido ke gani
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Tashi, yi zagaye mai sauƙi, ku sauka yayin da kuke ganin drone ɗin.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: A tashin gwaji ko wanda aka ba da izini, za ku iya tashi, yin zagaye mai sauƙi da sauka yayin da kuke ganin drone ɗin, a cikin iyakar tsayi ta doka, da sauka akwai sauran caji a batir.
Ganin ido kai tsaye (VLOS) yana nufin ku, ko mai taimaka muku kallo, kuna ganin drone da idanunku, ba tare da madubin hangen nesa ba, a duk lokacin tashi. Yawancin tashin gona na ƙananan manoma da sababbin matuƙa VLOS ne. Tashi fiye da inda ido ke gani yana buƙatar izini na musamman. Misali, Kashi na 21 na Najeriya yana buƙatar VLOS don ƙananan drones, kuma ya sa tsayi mafi girma na mita 120 (ƙafa 400) sama da ƙasa don ayyuka da yawa; ku duba iyakar ƙasarku.
Ku tashi daga wurinku mai sarari, ku hau zuwa tsayi mai aminci sama da itatuwa, ku tsaya cak a sama na 'yan daƙiƙoƙi don ku ga drone ɗin ya tsaya daidai. Ku tuƙa a hankali. Ku riƙe drone a gabanku, ba a saman kanku ko a bayanku ba, don kada ku rasa sanin inda yake fuskanta.
Ku kula da batir da iska. Ku sauka da isasshen caji don sauka lafiya, ba a kashi na ƙarshe ba. Idan iska tana tura drone ɗin sosai, ku dawo da shi ku sauka.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku tsaya a wurin tashinku tare da mai taimaka muku kallo.
- Ku tashi ku hau sama da itatuwa; ku tsaya cak ku duba ya tsaya daidai.
- Ku tuƙa a hankali a siffar murabba'i a gabanku, kuna ganinsa.
- Ku kula da batir da iska a kan allo.
- Ku dawo, ku sauko a hankali, ku sauka akwai sauran caji.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- VLOS: visual line of sight (ganin ido kai tsaye): kuna ganin drone da idanunku a duk lokacin tashi.
- BVLOS: beyond visual line of sight (fiye da ganin ido): tashi zuwa inda ba ku gani; yana buƙatar izini na musamman.
- AGL: above ground level (sama da ƙasa): tsayin da aka auna daga ƙasar da ke ƙarƙashin drone.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Hukumar Kula da Sufurin Jiragen Sama ta Najeriya (NCAA): Nig.CARs 2023 Kashi na 21, Jiragen da ake tuƙawa daga nesa (RPAS)
- Hukumar Kula da Sufurin Jiragen Sama ta Kenya (KCAA): Jirage marasa matuƙi (Unmanned Aircraft Systems)
Gwada yanzu: Idan kuna da drone da izini, ku tuƙa murabba'i a hankali a gabanku ku sauka akwai sauran caji. Idan ba ku da su, ku yi amfani da manhajar kwaikwayon tuƙin drone kyauta (simulator) ko ku kalli bidiyon horo ku rubuta matakan da kuka gani.
Yanzu za ku iya tashi, yin zagaye mai sauƙi a inda ido ke gani, da sauka lafiya akwai sauran caji.

check.q: Riƙe drone "a gabanku" yana taimakawa da me?
check.why: Riƙe drone a gabanku, ba a saman kanku ko a bayanku ba, yana taimaka muku ku san inda yake fuskanta.

check.q: Nan da nan bayan tashi, iska tana tura drone sosai. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku dawo da shi ku sauka
Ku hau sama don ku guje wa iskar
Ku ƙara sauri don ku gama
Ku kau da kai ku bar shi ya tashi
check.why: Idan iska tana tura drone sosai, ku dawo da shi ku sauka.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Shirya tashin taswira mai sarrafa kansa
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Shirya tashin taswira mai layuka da tsayi, haɗuwar hotuna da saurin da suka dace.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Don gonar da za a yi wa taswira, za ku iya shirya tashin taswira mai layuka da tsayi, girman bayanin hoto, haɗuwar hotuna, sauri da batura, da haɗuwar hotuna kusan kashi 70 zuwa 80 a gaba da kashi 60 zuwa 70 a gefe.
Don yin taswirar gona, drone yana tashi gaba da baya a layuka madaidaita (grid, wani lokaci ana kiransa salon injin yanka ciyawa, lawnmower) yana ɗaukar hotunan da ke haɗuwa da juna. Manhajojin taswira suna bar ku zana iyakar gonar, sannan su shirya muku layukan.
Tsayi ne ke saita bayanin hoto. Idan kun yi sama sosai, kowane pixel (ɗigon hoto) yana rufe ƙasa mai yawa, bayanin yana raguwa, amma kuna gamawa da sauri. Manhajar tana nuna wannan a matsayin GSD (ground sampling distance), misali cm 2 a kowane pixel. Don ƙirga shukar masara kuna buƙatar cikakken bayani; don ganin wuraren da ruwa ya kwanta, bayani mara zurfi ma ya isa. Kada ku taɓa shirya tashi sama da iyakar tsayi ta doka.
Haɗuwar hotuna (overlap) ita ce yawan abin da kowane hoto ke rabawa da na gaba. Manhaja tana buƙatar haɗuwa mai yawa don ta haɗa hotuna su zama taswira ɗaya; jagororin taswira da yawa suna ba da shawarar kusan kashi 70 zuwa 80 a gaba da kashi 60 zuwa 70 a gefe, da ƙari a kan amfanin gona masu tsayi da kamanni ɗaya kamar masara ko shayi. Ku tuƙa a hankali har hotuna su yi kyau, kuma ku shirya isassun batura don ku gama.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku zana iyakar gonar a manhajar taswira.
- Ku zaɓi tsayi: ku duba GSD da yake bayarwa, ku zauna ƙasa da iyakar doka.
- Ku saita haɗuwar hotuna ta gaba da ta gefe (misali kashi 75 da 65).
- Ku duba lokacin tashi da adadin batura.
- Ku ajiye tsarin ku sake duba shi kafin ku je gona.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Tashi mai layuka (grid flight): tashi a layuka madaidaita gaba da baya da ke rufe gonar gaba ɗaya.
- Haɗuwar hotuna (overlap): yawan abin da kowane hoto ke rabawa da na gaba, a kashi.
- GSD: ground sampling distance: yawan ƙasar da pixel ɗaya ke rufewa, kamar cm 2.
- Orthomosaic: babban hoto ɗaya mai daidaiton taswira da aka haɗa daga hotuna masu yawa da ke haɗuwa.
Gwada yanzu: Ku buɗe manhajar taswira ko ta shirya tashi kyauta (ko mai shirya tashi da ke cikin manhajar drone ɗinku) ku zana gona ta hekta 2. Ku gwada tsayi uku ku rubuta GSD da lokacin tashi na kowanne.
Yanzu za ku iya shirya tashin taswira mai layuka da zaɓar tsayi, haɗuwar hotuna da sauri don aikin.

check.q: Mene ne salon grid ko na injin yanka ciyawa?
options: Layuka madaidaita gaba da baya a kan gonar
check.why: Tashin taswira yana bin layuka madaidaita gaba da baya don hotunan su rufe gonar gaba ɗaya da haɗuwa.

check.q: Kuna son ƙirga shukar masara amma tsarinku yana ba da bayani mara zurfi. Me za ku canja?
options: Ku yi ƙasa don GSD mai zurfi, a cikin iyakar doka
check.why: Tashi ƙasa yana ba da cikakken bayani a kowane pixel, amma kada ku taɓa wuce iyakar doka.

chapters.name: Babi na 2: Ɗaukar hotuna daga sama da na'urorin ji

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Hotuna masu launi (RGB): abin da za ku iya gani
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Karanta hoton drone mai launi da cikakken bayani don neman giɓi, ciyawa, ruwa da lalacewa.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku hoton drone mai launi da cikakken bayani, za ku iya nuna giɓi, ciyawa, ruwa, faɗuwar karan amfanin gona da lalacewa, da yi wa kowane wuri alama don a duba shi da ƙafa.
Kyamarar launi ta yau da kullum (RGB) ita ce na'urar ji mafi amfani ga yawancin gonaki, kuma tana zuwa da kusan kowane drone. A 'yan santimita a kowane pixel, kuna iya ganin shukar masara, wake ko rogo ɗaya-ɗaya.
A hotuna masu launi ku nemi: giɓi a layuka (tsiro marar kyau ko shukar da kwari suka cinye), tarin ciyawa tsakanin layuka, ruwa da ya kwanta da ƙasa marar komai, masara ko dawa da suka faɗi (lodging), lalacewa daga ƙanƙara ko iska, shanu ko awaki a wurin da bai dace ba, da magudanan ruwa da suka toshe ko shingaye da suka karye.
Hotuna masu launi suna iya nuna alamun matsalar sinadaran ƙasa ko cuta (rawayewa, kore marar daidai), amma suna nuna ta a makare fiye da idon da ke ƙasa ko kyamarar multispectral. Koyaushe ku yi wa wurin alama ku duba shi da ƙafa.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku buɗe hoton ko taswirar ku nuna gonar gaba ɗaya.
- Ku nemi duk wani abu marar daidai: giɓi, canjin launi, ruwa, ƙasa marar komai.
- Ku zuƙo kowanne.
- Ku yi wa kowane wuri alama da lamba da ɗan bayani.
- Ku tafi wuraren da ƙafa ku duba su.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Hoto mai cikakken bayani (high-resolution): hoto mai bayani dalla-dalla, inda kowane pixel ke rufe ɗan ƙaramin yanki na ƙasa.
- Faɗuwar kara (lodging): lokacin da karan masara, dawa ko alkama ya lanƙwasa ko ya faɗi.
Gwada yanzu: Ku nemo hoton drone ko hoton tauraron ɗan adam na gona a intanet (ko ku yi amfani da naku). Ku jera abubuwa biyar da kuke gani, ku nuna inda kowanne yake, ku faɗi abin da za ku duba a ƙasa.
Yanzu za ku iya karanta hoton drone mai launi da yi wa giɓi, ciyawa, ruwa da lalacewa alama don a duba su a ƙasa.

check.q: A hoto mai launi, me giɓi a layi zai iya nunawa?
options: Tsiro marar kyau ko shukar da kwari suka cinye
check.why: Giɓi a layuka sau da yawa yana nufin iri bai tsiro ba ko an cinye shukar.

check.q: Hoton yana nuna wani yanki mai rawaya, marar daidai a gonar wake. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku fesa maganin a gonar gaba ɗaya
Ku yi wa wurin alama ku duba shi da ƙafa
check.why: Hotuna masu launi suna iya nuna alamun matsala, amma dole a duba wurin a ƙasa.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Na'urorin ji na multispectral da na zafi (thermal)
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Zaɓi tsakanin na'urar ji ta RGB, multispectral da ta zafi don tambaya game da gona.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku tambaya game da gona, za ku iya zaɓar tsakanin na'urar ji ta RGB, multispectral da ta zafi (thermal), da dalilin da ya dace da tambayar da kuɗin.
Ganyaye kore masu lafiya suna mayar da hasken near-infrared (NIR) mai yawa, wanda ido ba ya gani. Ganyaye masu damuwa ko marasa lafiya suna mayar da ƙasa da haka. Kyamarar multispectral tana auna rukunonin haske da yawa, har da near-infrared da red edge, don manhaja ta lissafa ma'aunin shuke-shuke (vegetation index) kamar NDVI da ke nuna ƙarfin girman shuka. FAO tana amfani da NDVI daga taurarin ɗan adam don bin lafiyar shuke-shuke a ko'ina a Afirka; drones suna yin haka a matakin gona.
Kyamarar zafi (thermal) tana auna zafin saman abu. Shukar da ba ta da isasshen ruwa tana rufe ƙofofin numfashinta ta yi zafi, don haka hotunan zafi suna iya nuna ƙarancin ruwa da bututun ban ruwa da suka toshe. Kyamarar zafi kuma tana da kyau wajen nemo dabbobi da dare ko da asuba.
Waɗannan na'urorin ji sun fi tsada kuma suna buƙatar kulawa (daidaitawa, lokacin rana da ya dace). Ku zaɓe su idan tambayar tana buƙatarsu: damuwar shuka da wuri a gonar shayi ko kayan lambu da ake ban ruwa, eh; ƙirga giɓi a gonar wake ta eka 1, a'a, launi ya isa.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Near-infrared (NIR): hasken da ke bayan ja kaɗan da mutane ba sa gani; ganyaye masu lafiya suna mayar da shi da yawa.
- Ma'aunin shuke-shuke (vegetation index): lambar da aka lissafa daga rukunonin haske da ke nuna yadda shuke-shuke suke kore da ƙarfi.
- NDVI: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index: ma'aunin shuke-shuke da aka saba daga haske ja da near-infrared, daga -1 zuwa +1; mafi girma yawanci yana nufin shuke-shuke kore masu yawa da lafiya.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- FAO GIEWS: Kallon Duniya daga sama (NDVI da alamomin shuke-shuke)
- FAO da ITU: E-agriculture in Action: Drones for Agriculture (Jirage marasa matuƙi don noma, 2018)
Gwada yanzu: Ga kowace tambaya, ku zaɓi RGB, multispectral ko zafi ku rubuta dalili: (a) Bututun ban ruwa na ɗigo-ɗigo (drip) ya toshe? (b) A ina wake bai tsiro ba? (c) Akwai wani yanki na shayi da ke cikin damuwa kafin ganyen ya canja launi?
Yanzu za ku iya faɗin abin da na'urorin ji na multispectral da na zafi ke nunawa da zaɓar na'urar ji da ta dace don tambaya game da gona.

check.why: Kyamarar zafi tana auna zafin saman abu, wanda zai iya nuna ƙarancin ruwa.

check.q: Wata gonar shayi tana son gano damuwar shuka da wuri a dukkan yankunanta. Wace na'urar ji za ku ba da shawara?
check.why: Kyamarorin multispectral suna auna near-infrared da red edge, da ke nuna damuwar shuka da wuri.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Ɗaukar hotuna masu kyau: haske, iska da lokaci
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Shirya tashi ta yadda kowane hoto zai yi kyau, haskensa ya yi daidai, kuma ya yi amfani.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: A ranar tashin taswira, za ku iya saita lokaci, iyakar haske da iska, da duba kowane hoto kafin barin gonar, don hotunan su yi kyau, haskensu ya yi daidai, kuma su cika.
Hotunan da aka ɗauka bayan makonni za a iya kwatanta su ne kawai idan an ɗauke su ta hanya ɗaya. Ku tashi kusan tsakar rana, lokacin da inuwa ke gajarta, kuma a haske mai tsayayye: ko rana cikakkiya ko gizagizai daidai, ba gizagizai masu tabo-tabo da ke wucewa a kan gonar ba. Ku tashi a tsayi da saituna iri ɗaya kowane lokaci.
Iska tana girgiza drone kuma tana motsa ganyaye, wanda ke ɓata hotuna kuma yana hana haɗawa. Ku rage sauri a iska kaɗan, kada ku tashi ko kaɗan a iska mai ƙarfi. Ku tabbata ruwan tabarau (lens) yana da tsafta kuma an saita kyamara ta mai da hankali daidai; manhajojin taswira da yawa suna saita kyamarar muku.
Don kyamarorin multispectral, ku ɗauki hoton allon daidaitawa (calibration panel, katin da aka san yadda yake mayar da haske, wanda ke zuwa da na'urar ji) kafin da bayan tashi, don manhaja ta gyara bambancin haske. Kafin ku bar gonar, ku duba hotunan: idan wasu ba su fita sosai ba, sun yi duhu ko sun ɓace, ku sake tashi a wannan sashe tun kuna nan.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku shirya tashi kusan tsakar rana a haske mai tsayayye.
- Ku duba iska; ku rage sauri a iska kaɗan, ku fasa a iska mai ƙarfi.
- Ku goge ruwan tabarau; ku duba saitunan kyamara.
- Multispectral: ku ɗauki hoton allon daidaitawa kafin da bayan tashi.
- Kafin ku tafi, ku duba hotunan ku sake tashi a duk sashen da bai yi kyau ba.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Allon daidaitawa (calibration panel): katin da aka san haskensa da ake ɗaukar hotonsa kafin da bayan tashin multispectral don gyara bambancin haske.
- Ɓaci (blur): lokacin da hoto bai fita sosai ba saboda kyamara ko shuke-shuke sun motsa.
Gwada yanzu: Aikin ƙarshe: ku rubuta cikakken tsarin tashin ɗaukar hotuna don gonar masara ta hekta 2: manufa, na'urar ji, tsayi da GSD, haɗuwar hotuna, sauri, batura, lokacin rana, iyakar yanayi, wurin tashi da jerin bincike. Idan kuna da drone da izinin da ake buƙata, ku tuƙa shi ku duba kowane hoto kafin ku tafi.
Yanzu za ku iya shirya da ɗaukar rukunin hotuna masu kyau, masu haske daidai, da za a iya haɗa su su zama taswirar gona kuma a kwatanta su a tsawon lokaci.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce Manufa da na'urar ji Babu manufa, ko na'urar ji ba ta dace da manufar ba. Manufar tashi a sarari da na'urar ji da ta dace da ita, tare da dalili. Ya bayyana dalilin da ya sa ba a zaɓi na'urar ji mafi arha ko mafi tsada ba. Tsayi, bayani da haɗuwar hotuna Babu tsayi, GSD ko haɗuwar hotuna, ko ya wuce iyakar tsayi ta doka. Tsayi da GSD da manhaja ta nuna, haɗuwar hotuna ta gaba da ta gefe, sauri da adadin batura. Ya nuna yadda bayanin ya dace da aikin, kamar ƙirga shuke-shuke. Haske, iska da lokaci Babu lokacin rana ko iyakar yanayi. Lokacin rana, haske, iyakar iska da shirin duba kowane hoto kafin barin gona. Ya haɗa da matakan allon daidaitawa ko ranar ajiya. Jerin binciken kafin tashi Jerin binciken ya rasa jirgi, batura, saituna ko takardu. Ya ƙunshi jirgi, batura, na'urar tuƙi da manhaja, saitunan komawa gida da takardu. Ya ƙara wurin tashi da yadda drone zai kasance a inda ake gani. Tuƙi lafiya Babu wurin tashi, ko tashi fiye da ganin ido ba tare da izini ba. Wurin tashi a sarari, tashi a inda ido ke gani da cikin tsayin doka, da sauka akwai sauran caji. Ya ambaci mai taimakawa kallo da matakan da za a ɗauka idan iska ta ƙaru. Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku gyara wannan sashe na tsarin ku sake duba shi.
